title: Backslot Mod: Json Generator
description: This is a mod made so you can generate the json files for adding compatibility to the Backslot Mod!
body:
# Backslot Mod: Json Generator

This mod lets you generate json files for making resource packs or mods compatible with the [Backslot Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/backslot-mod) through an interactive GUI.

### How to use:

Step 1: Install the mod and join a world.

Step 2: Open the pause menu.

Step 3: Press the button in the top left corner of your screen.

Step 4: Configure as you wish and press the `Generate File` button, which will generate a new file located at `YOUR MODPACK FOLDER/back_transforms/YOUR_ITEM.json`.

Step 5: Put that file into your resource pack or mod (for mods under `assets/MOD_ID/back_transforms`).

Congratulations! You should now see the item properly positioned when in the Backslot.

> Make sure to use the [Backslot Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/backslot-mod) so you can see the changes in-game!
